description: Add USDC to your workspace's prepaid balance with one x402 payment signed by your own wallet. amount is in USDC, such as "25". Called without payment it spends nothing and returns the payment requirements to sign. Sign them, then call again with the same amount and payment set to the base64 payment (the value of the X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). The result gives the credited amount, any bonus and the new balance; get_billing_settings shows the terms. Needs a Last Price credential with the price:compute scope.

amount.description: USDC to add, with at most 6 decimals, such as "25" or "25.50".

payment.description: Optional. The signed x402 payment, base64, as sent in an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Omit it to read what the call costs and how to pay; nothing is charged until you send it.

name: top_up_balance
